definition.gross_leverage: Total debt ÷ EBITDA. n.m. when EBITDA is zero or negative.

definition.liquidity: Cash + cash-like investments + undrawn committed facilities.
definition.net_debt: Total debt − cash and cash-like investments. Negative means net cash.
